eps.t: Day One at the Bar None
eps.d: Another summer at the Bar None Ranch begins with the arrival of a new employee!
Ted and Danny take on Brad and Melody in various competitions in a battle of the sexes!

Buddy Ernst finally finds something to like at the ranch, a yellow-maned pony named Goldilocks. When Buddy learns that his father plans to sell the horse, he and Goldilocks head out into the heat of the desert.
Ted's selfishness and desire for a saddle that once belonged to John Wayne get him in trouble.
Brad and Melody want the chance to lead overnight camping trips in the desert, but only one of them may do it. Who will it be?
Melody falls in love with a guest at the ranch. The gang helps her prepare for her date.
A bank robber visits the Bar None Ranch.

eps.t: The Good, the Bad, and the Obnoxious
eps.d: An old rival of Brad visits the ranch.
Danny must choose between his friends and his Native American heritage.
Ted and Brad accidentally handcuff each other together. Will they survive until the locksmith arrives?
The kids think one of the guests is a murderer.
Tension builds among the staff when Mr. Ernst announces the title of Employee of the Week.
Teds carelessness results in an injury to Danny.
Ted and Melody learn the consequences of spilling secrets.
The kids compete to see who is worthy of a $100 tip left by a guest.
Melody trains to become an Olympic champion. Can she handle the pressure?
Tension builds among the boys and girls.
A small plane crashes on the Bar None Ranch. Why is the pilot acting so strange?
The kids tell ghost stories.
Ted's English teacher visits the Bar None Ranch.
Cleaning out the garbage in the back, Ted finds a map to a buried treasure.
Danny feels responsible for the near-death of a horse.
Melody falls head over heels for her favorite TV heartthrob who's visiting the ranch.
It's a nightmare come true when Ted loses the child he is baby-sitting.
The gang tries to convince Mr. Ernst not to sell the Bar None Ranch.
The gang is terrified when they observe men in space suits roaming the Bar None Ranch.
Mr. Ernst puts Ted in charge of the ranch while he is out for the day. Chaos ensues!
The Bar None Ranch is visited by a bunch of rich snobs.
Ted convinces Brad to go on a date with him before he leaves to go to summer school.
Jake, Mr. Ernst's trouble-making nephew, comes to stay at the Bar None Ranch.
When an old friend of Melody's comes to visit, Melody finds that nothing ever stays the same.
Jake's superstitious nature prevents him from trying out for a TV game show.
A rival ranch (Snake Eyes Ranch) challenges the Bar None to a baseball game for the water rights.
Mr. Ernst's ex-wife arrives at the ranch.
After being constantly taken advantage of by her friends, Melody decides to go on strike.
Mr. Ernst becomes a professional wrestler to keep from losing the ranch's money.
Melody helps her brother with a problem.
Buddy is put in charge of a trouble-making guest at the ranch.
After meeting Brad, Kyle decides to stay at the Bar None Ranch for the summer.
The Vlecks stay at the Bar None Ranch while the Snake Eyes Ranch is being repaired.
Bradley learns the true meaning of Christmas from her friendship with a disabled boy.
Mr. Ernst becomes sheriff, and Danny and Buddy work on the first living-desert museum.
Danny writes an unflattering comic strip about the Bar None Ranch and its staff members.
The pool at the Bar None Ranch will close unless the staff becomes certified in life saving procedures.
Brad and Meloday try to cheer up Mr. Ernst but their plans go awry.
Brad and Kyle are tied up and left in the desert during a camping trip.
Jake discovers the identity of a mysterious peeping Tom who's been bothering the gang.
An archaeologist discovers a sacred Indian burial ground at the Bar None.
Jake solves the neighbors' dispute.
Danny and Jake's impersonations of visiting travel writers fool Mr. Ernst.
Because of financial difficulties, Mr. Ernst considers selling the Bar None.
Mr. Ernst and the staff plan a murder-mystery night to raise money for the ranch.
Melody becomes obsessed with winning a beauty pageant.
To keep Jake from being fired, the staff invents an imaginary worker to blame for his mistakes.
The staff tries to convince Ted that he is shrinking.
The kids, under the misconception that Mr. Ernst is dying, try to keep him awake.
The kids try to take care of a baby left behind at the ranch until the mother returns.
Ted and Kyle must rely on each other to escape the danger of the desert.
Mr. Ernst develops amnesia.
Jake and Buddy investigate a case of thievery in which Ted is the prime suspect.
Buddy develops romantic feelings for Melody.
Brad's father loses his job. The gang helps her save money.
Jake takes on two bullies at the Bar None Ranch.
Ted asks Melody out to make Brad jealous.
The gang plays an night-time game of Capture the Flag.
